correctness.rationale: A successful origin attempt at u has density e^(-2u) du. Given its success, both half rays are conditionally independent with occupancy parameter q_t(u)=1-(1-u)e^(u-t) at sites +/-2. Normalized U-density is 2e^(-2u)/(1-e^(-2t)); integrating z_t(U)=(1-U)e^(U-t) and z_t(U)^2 gives 2t/(e^(2t)-1) and 2(t-t^2+t^3/3)/(e^(2t)-1). Covariance is exactly Var(q_t(U))>0 since q_t is strictly increasing on (0,t). Independent symbolic integration and positivity numerical samples agree. Infinite-volume local dependence follows factorial decreasing-priority path tail; t=1 gap table is mathematically implied by known pairs and NOT original.
residual_risks: The model is single attempt per site; formula does not describe other deposition/continuous parking protocols.
